title: Structural Formula, Contracted Formula and Bond Line Notation
topicTitle: Idea of structural formula, contracted formula and bond line structural formula
notes: **Structural formula:** shows all atoms and all bonds. Complete but verbose: $CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_3$ for butane.
**Condensed formula:** groups atoms bonded to the same carbon together. $CH_3CH_2CH_2CH_3$.

**Bond line notation:** carbon atoms are implied at line ends and vertices; hydrogens are omitted except where needed for functional groups. Each vertex represents a carbon with enough hydrogens to make four bonds.
**Example:** bond line for butane is a simple zigzag of four vertices. For isobutane, a three-carbon chain with a methyl branch at the middle carbon.
**Functional group priority:** when drawing bond lines, functional groups must be explicit. OH, COOH, $NH_2$ are always shown.
